item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 21/Oct/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The easterly airstream now affecting the coast of Guangdong will moderate gradually today and tomorrow. A dry northeast monsoon is expected to reach southern China on Tuesday. The weather will be generally fine over the region in the following few days. It will be slightly cooler in the morning and at night. The temperature difference between day and night will be rather large. Besides, the tropical cyclone over the western North Pacific to the east of the Philippines will intensify gradually and move towards the seas east of Luzon in the next few days. However, there are uncertainties in its subsequent movement.
